omitted: Worker PIDs and process-instance identifiers, local output paths, execution timestamps, and per-request wait/lag arrays. Synthetic counters, CPU totals, lane progress, KV timings, source hashes, order and seeds remain. Aggregates include pooled quantiles computed before the original wait/lag arrays were omitted.

metadata.process_model: multiprocessing spawn; independent event loops and Redis clients
metadata.held_scope: 2 ms, or 2% 200 ms for mixed; no HTTP/PG/accounting
metadata.normalization: CPU and attempts use all completions including drain; throughput uses fixed window
metadata.latency_injection: half before and half after Redis SET/EVAL; within original KV deadlines
